title: Paul McCartney live: TaxSlayer Center, Moline | 2019
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the TaxSlayer Center in Moline, Illinois, USA, on 11 June 2019.

It was the 31st show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019. This concert was seen by 10,613 fans.

Rock music legend Sir @PaulMcCartney performs at the TaxSlayer Center in Moline, Tuesday. The former Beatle made his first visit to the Quad-Cities as a part of the Freshen Up tour. https://t.co/nNFNyJacCX @qctimes @Dispatch_Argus #SirPaulQC #FreshenUpTour #PaulMcCartney pic.twitter.com/7EzGRgwHtF

— Andy Abeyta (@andy_abeyta) June 12, 2019

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
